prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a portrait of a young man standing against a plain, light gray background. He has a quirky, nerdy appearance, with neatly parted dark hair and a single, exaggerated spike of hair sticking straight up from the top of his head. He wears large, thick-rimmed black glasses and a white, short-sleeved button-up shirt with subtle vertical stripes. A striped tie is loosely knotted at his neck, and several pens are visible in his shirt pocket, emphasizing his studious persona. The subject is smiling slightly, with a thoughtful expression, resting his chin on one hand in a classic "thinking" pose. The lighting is soft and even, casting minimal shadows and highlighting the subject’s features and unique hairstyle. The overall style is clean and minimalist, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus entirely on the subject, evoking a playful, character-driven portrait reminiscent of a stylized studio photograph.
